bullets.title: Bruce Lee at the 1967 Long Beach Tournament
bullets.note: Bruce was so far ahead of his time, it’s hard to believe. How did I not find this video sooner?! The audio includes a lot of great anecdotes as a bonus.

bullets.title: Louis Armstrong & Duke Ellington: The Complete Louis Armstrong and Duke Ellington Sessions
bullets.note: Normally, I can’t listen to music with lyrics while I work; the words interfere with my thinking and typing. That isn’t so with this album, for whatever reason. Its soothing tracks allow my body to relax and my mind to wander into corners I didn’t even know were productive. Your mileage may vary, but it’s been a wonderful new audio sanctuary for calming down and writing.
